checks.item: C1. every method faces the same network, horizon, fleet, action bound and reward scales
checks.detail: 4 methods compared on 11 environment properties; all identical

checks.item: C2. the environment builder cannot specialise the world to the method
checks.detail: build_env(cell: 'Cell', *, trained_forecaster: 'bool' = True): the cell names the method, but the scenario, seed and frozen configuration determine the world; there is no method-conditional branch in the simulator or the demand process

checks.item: C3. common random numbers are structural: the stream factory has no method argument
checks.detail: environment_streams(scenario: 'str', eval_seed: 'int') -> 'dict[str, np.random.Generator]' -- a method cannot influence the realisation it faces

checks.item: C3b. the same (scenario, eval_seed) reproduces the same streams
checks.detail: 9 named streams drawn twice at ('surge', 7) and compared over 32 draws each

checks.item: C3d. swapping the forecast provider does not desynchronise the realised world
checks.detail: three methods stepped through the same 24 actions at ('surge', 11) experienced identical arrivals and queues. fixed_timetable is built with the seasonal-naive provider and the others with the trained one; neither provider consumes randomness, so the worlds coincide

checks.item: C3c. scenarios at one eval_seed share a base world (amendment A-03)
checks.detail: the demand stream is identical across scenario families at the same evaluation seed, so a scenario contrast measures the scenario rather than a different draw

checks.item: C4. the heuristic reads the forecast mean but never sigma
checks.detail: resolves `queue_length` and `forecast_mu_h1` only; no reference to any sigma channel

checks.item: C4b. the rolling MILP reads sigma, as its registration requires
checks.detail: milp_rolling plans against mu + Z*sigma with Z = 1.0. Protocol section 7.1 registers this method as receiving sigma, so withholding it would make the strongest optimisation baseline weaker than the one registered -- an asymmetry favouring the proposed method

checks.item: C4c. the static MILP sees only the historical average day
checks.detail: milp_static solves once on the fitted demand process's mean for the day type and executes open-loop; it never observes the realised episode

checks.item: C4d. the three uncertainty arms are distinct and all registered
checks.detail: {'ppo_point': 'point', 'ppo_placebo': 'placebo', 'ppo_uq': 'uq'} -- point zeroes sigma, placebo replaces it with a draw of the same marginal distribution and no association, uq passes it through. All three keep the same observation dimensionality and parameter count

checks.item: C5. reading a forecast feature at or after the issue hour raises
checks.detail: HistoryBuffer.value_at(10, issue_hour=10) raises IndexError; future information cannot enter a feature by accident because the accessor refuses rather than returning it

checks.item: C5b. the leakage test suite is present and covers every method's inputs
checks.detail: tests\test_leakage.py injects a future spike and requires every feature to be unchanged, with a positive control that a past change does move them

checks.item: C6. baseline tuning seeds are disjoint from every scored pool
checks.detail: tuning pools {'heuristic_threshold': [2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006], 'milp_surrogate': [3001, 3002, 3003, 3004]}; scored pools are evaluation 1-30, training 101-110, pilot evaluation 41-50; no overlap

checks.item: C6b. the heuristic's selected thresholds are interior to its search grid
checks.detail: queue interior=True, forecast interior=True over 45 grid points (amendment A-10: extend the queue grid until the selection is strictly interior). A selection at a boundary means the optimum probably lies outside the grid, which would understate the baseline

checks.item: C6c. the RL arms share one frozen hyperparameter configuration
checks.detail: amendment A-05: no PPO hyperparameter search is run, and one documented configuration (src/rl/train.py PPOConfig) is applied unchanged to every arm, so the proposed arm cannot be tuned harder than its ablations

checks.item: C7. every stored method was evaluated on the same evaluation seeds
checks.detail: 4 method(s) stored; all use the full registered pool of 30 evaluation seeds in every scenario

checks.item: C7c. each method used exactly the forecaster its registration gives it
checks.detail: {'fixed_timetable': ['naive_seasonal'], 'heuristic_threshold': ['xgb_quantile'], 'milp_rolling': ['xgb_quantile'], 'milp_static': ['xgb_quantile']}. ['fixed_timetable'] consume no forecast (protocol section 7.1 gives the fixed timetable nothing beyond the clock), so they are built with the seasonal-naive provider; every other method uses the trained M4 model. Check C3d confirms this substitution does not change the world any method faces
